title: 第11章  妖女来救场
slug: 让你当炉做鼎你炼阴阳证大道
content_zh:
“得赶紧离开。”
李寒山收回目光，扫了一眼四周后，便快步朝花弄影院子的方向奔去。
此番他坏了赵元的好事，万一这家伙杀回来，他必死无疑。
“快，拦住他，别让他走了！”
孙泽见状，目光一寒，带着几个跟班就拦了上去。
这家伙很聪明，他惹到了许灵溪，现在许灵溪拜了金丹老师，以后必定崛起，他很可能没有好果子吃。所以，他决定抱一个大腿。
以他的实力与身份，在外门也就勉强混得开，太粗的大腿根本抱不上，目前唯一能够够到的，就是赵元这个外门执事了。
正好可以借此报一报那一巴掌之仇！
至于花弄影，只要抱上赵元的大腿，在他看来根本不是啥大问题。
孙泽几人刚好在李寒山离开的方位上，将他堵了个正着。他脸上带着狞笑，看向李寒山的目光里满是恨意。
“老东西，惹到了赵前辈，还想跑啊？”
孙泽说到这里，故意拉长了声音：“可惜，你跑不掉咯！”
李寒山脸色一沉，他看出了孙泽的歹毒心思，这是想将自己拖住，等赵元回来，自己便死无葬身之地。
“炼气五层。”
他没有说话，悄然感知了一下孙泽的灵力波动，对方比他强一些，应该是炼气五层。这家伙还有几个跟班，正面打起来，优势不在他！
孙泽见李寒山沉默，张开腿，指着胯下，笑道：“想走吧？来来来，从这里钻过去，再喊几声爷爷，爷爷我心情一好，说不定放你走。”
李寒山终于开口：“我可是花弄影的炉鼎....”
孙泽打断他：“老东西，你说到哪里去了，我怎么敢动花师姐的炉鼎。我只是找你叙叙旧而已。”
说到这里，他神色一厉：“再说了，身为花师姐的炉鼎，你居然跟许灵溪那贱....许师妹勾搭不清，你觉得花师姐会轻饶你？”
“花弄影要怎么处罚我是我的事。”

李寒山声音一寒，指着孙泽，冷声道：“你把我的话当耳边风是吧，是不是忘了我上次的警告了？”
他不说还好，一说，孙泽就差点跳了起来，他将脸凑了过来，指着自己的脸，激动道：
“打我是吧？来啊，你打啊，来来来，往这里打。”
他就不信，李寒山今天还敢打他。
“啪！”
响亮的耳光声响起，紧接着，剧痛传来，孙泽的脸火辣辣地疼，半边脸瞬间肿了起来，嘴角沁出一丝血迹。
他整个人被打得偏过头去，踉跄了两步，脑子里嗡嗡作响，一时间竟没能反应过来。
“这可是你让我打的。”李寒山对这一巴掌的效果很满意：“我活了大半辈子，还是头一次听见有人提这种要求。”
“好好好！”
孙泽气笑了，身上灵力涌动：“今天不把你废掉，我就不信孙。老东西，劳资要还手了，有种你自杀一个给劳资看看！”
话音未落，他便看到李寒山的指尖出现了一个硕大的火球。这让他不由一愣，似乎是没反应过来火球为什么会出现在李寒山指尖。
也就这一愣，他的反应慢了一拍，那火球已然飞了过来。
“孙师兄小心～”几个跟班的惊呼声响起。
孙泽反应还算快，赶紧施展一个防御术法，但由于太过匆忙，这术法才施展到一半，火球便已到来，在他胸前炸开。
“轰~”
孙泽直接被炸飞了出去，重重地落在地上，连吐了好几口鲜血。
“孙师兄！”
“炼气四层，至少是炼气四层！”
“嘶！他只是一个炉鼎，怎么可能这么厉害？我都才炼气四层！”
孙泽的几个跟班大惊失色，他们万万没想到，李寒山居然会这么厉害，进入合欢宗这才一个多月，竟然都炼气四层了！

最关键的是，他还是一个炉鼎！
“轰轰轰~”
趁着这群跟班震惊的功夫，李寒山连续释放出三枚火弹攻向跟班们，跟班们被炸得狼狈不堪，原本围堵的阵型被撕开了一个口子。
李寒山脚下火光一闪，火影步全力施展，身形如鬼魅般从缺口处掠出，头也不回地朝山上狂奔。
“追！快追！”
孙泽从地上爬起来，抹了一把嘴角的血迹，声嘶力竭地吼道。
几个跟班这才回过神来，慌忙追了上去。可李寒山突破炼气四层后，火影步变得愈发玄妙，每一步踏出都带着火光，转眼间便将他们甩开了一大截。
“快了，快了！”
李寒山盯着前方那片密林，只要钻进林子，他就有把握甩掉这些人。
然而就在这时，一道人影从天而降，稳稳地落在他前方十丈处，挡住了他的去路。
来人正是赵元。
他负手而立，青衣猎猎，周身灵力涌动如山岳压顶，筑基期的威压毫不掩饰地释放出来，压得李寒山几乎喘不过气来。
“跑啊，怎么不跑了？”
赵元居高临下地看着李寒山，嘴角挂着一丝猫捉老鼠般的戏谑。
李寒山停下脚步，脸色铁青。
筑基期的威压太过恐怖，他被锁定之后，连动弹一下都觉得艰难，更别提逃跑了。
“一个破炉鼎，也敢坏我的好事？”
赵元慢悠悠地走过来，每走一步，威压便重一分：“你可知道，极阴之体有多难得？若是得到她，有生之年，我甚至有把握冲击金丹！”
他在李寒山面前站定，低头俯视着这个须发花白的老头，眼中杀意毫不掩饰：“你毁了我的前程，我拿你的命来抵，不过分吧？”
李寒山咬紧牙关，体内灵力疯狂运转，试图挣脱威压的束缚。可炼气与筑基之间的差距犹如天堑，他根本动弹不得。

他不甘心啊！
好不容易反杀了花弄影，竟又遇到这样的生死危机！
“放心，我不会让你死得太痛快的。”
赵元抬起手，指尖凝聚出一道锋利的灵刃，缓缓逼近李寒山的喉咙：“我会慢慢折磨你，让你求生不得，求死不能”
李寒山手捏着江念微给的灵符，随时准备激发。
可惜这只是防御灵符，不是攻击，必须要用在最关键的时候。
“住手！”
一道娇喝声从天际传来，打断了赵元的话。
紧接着，一道红影如流星般划破长空，瞬息之间便落在了李寒山身前。
花弄影一身红衣，青丝飞扬，那张倾国倾城的脸上写满了冷意。她手持长柄烟杆，烟杆末端还冒着袅袅青烟，整个人如同一朵带刺的玫瑰，妖艳而危险。
“赵元，你好大的胆子！”
花弄影目光如刀，死死盯着赵元，一字一顿道：“区区一个外门执事，竟敢动我的人？”
赵元冷笑：“花弄影，你别太嚣张。你不过一个炼气期的内门弟子，有什么资格在我面前指手画脚？”
“炼气期？”
花弄影仿佛听到了什么笑话，红唇微启，嗤笑一声：“我确实是炼气期。但我比你年轻三十岁，我今年才二十几，你呢？五十多了吧？修炼了这么多年才筑基，你有什么好得意的？”
content_en:
"You have to leave quickly."
Li Hanshan withdrew his gaze, glanced around, and then quickly ran towards the direction of Huanong Cinema.
This time he ruined Zhao Yuan's good deeds. If this guy comes back, he will definitely die.
"Quick, stop him, don't let him go!"
When Sun Ze saw this, his eyes turned cold, and he stopped him with a few followers.
This guy is very smart. He has offended Xu Lingxi. Now that Xu Lingxi has become a teacher of Jindan, he will definitely rise in the future. He will probably not get any good results. So, he decided to hug a thigh.
With his strength and identity, he can barely get through in the outer sect, and his thighs are too thick to hold him. The only one who can reach him currently is Zhao Yuan, the deacon of the outer sect.
This is just the right way to avenge that slap!
As for Hua Nongying, as long as she hugged Zhao Yuan's lap, it wasn't a big problem at all.
Sun Ze and others happened to be in the direction where Li Hanshan left and blocked him. There was a ferocious smile on his face, and his eyes were full of hatred when he looked at Li Hanshan.
"Old guy, you've provoked Senior Zhao and you still want to run away?"
When Sun Ze said this, he deliberately lengthened his voice: "It's a pity that you can't run away!"
Li Hanshan's face darkened. He saw Sun Ze's vicious thoughts. He wanted to hold him back so that when Zhao Yuan came back, he would die without a burial place.
"Fifth level of Qi refining."
He didn't speak, but quietly sensed Sun Ze's spiritual power fluctuations. He was stronger than him and should be at the fifth level of Qi Refining. This guy also has a few followers, so in a head-on fight, he won't have the advantage!
Seeing Li Hanshan's silence, Sun Ze opened his legs, pointed at his crotch, and said with a smile: "Want to leave? Come on, come on, crawl through here, call grandpa a few more times, grandpa, once I feel better, I might let you go."
Li Hanshan finally said: "I am Hua Nongying's furnace..."
Sun Ze interrupted him: "Old man, where did you go? How dare I touch Senior Sister Hua's furnace. I'm just catching up with you."
At this point, he looked stern: "Besides, as Senior Sister Hua's furnace, you actually have trouble getting along with that bitch Xu Lingxi... Junior Sister Xu. Do you think Senior Sister Hua will let you off lightly?"
"How Hua Nongying wants to punish me is my business."
Li Hanshan's voice turned cold, he pointed at Sun Ze and said coldly: "You turned a deaf ear to my words, right? Have you forgotten my last warning?"
It was okay if he didn't say it. As soon as he said it, Sun Ze almost jumped up. He brought his face closer, pointed at his own face, and said excitedly:
"Hit me, right? Come on, hit me, come on, hit me here."
He didn't believe that Li Hanshan dared to hit him today.
"Crack!"
A loud slap sounded, followed immediately by severe pain. Sun Ze's face was in burning pain, half of his face instantly swollen, and a trace of blood appeared at the corner of his mouth.
He was so beaten that he turned his head away and staggered two steps. His mind was buzzing and he couldn't react for a while.
"This is what you asked me to slap." Li Hanshan was very satisfied with the effect of this slap: "This is the first time in my life that I have heard someone make such a request."
"Okay, okay!"
Sun Ze laughed angrily, and his spiritual power surged in his body: "If I don't destroy you today, I won't trust Sun. Old guy, labor and management are going to fight back. If you dare, commit suicide and show labor and management!"
Before he finished speaking, he saw a huge fireball appear on Li Hanshan's fingertips. This made him stunned, as if he didn't realize why the fireball appeared at Li Hanshan's fingertips.
At this moment, his reaction was a beat slower, and the fireball had already flown over.
"Senior Brother Sun, be careful~" several followers exclaimed.
Sun Ze reacted quickly and quickly cast a defensive spell. However, due to his haste, the fireball arrived and exploded in his chest only halfway through the spell.
"Boom~"
Sun Ze was directly blown away, fell heavily to the ground, and vomited several mouthfuls of blood.
"Senior Brother Sun! "
"The fourth level of Qi refining, at least the fourth level of Qi refining! "
"Hiss! He is just a furnace, how could he be so powerful? I'm only at the fourth level of Qi refining! "
Several of Sun Ze's followers were shocked. They never expected that Li Hanshan could be so powerful. He had only been in the Hehuan Sect for more than a month and he was already at the fourth level of Qi Refining!
The most important thing is that he is still a furnace!
"Boom boom boom~"
While the followers were shocked, Li Hanshan released three fire bombs in succession to attack the followers. The followers were blown into a state of disarray, and a hole was torn open in the original containment formation.
There was a flash of fire at the foot of Li Han Mountain, and he used the Hokage Step with all his strength. His figure swept out of the gap like a ghost, and ran towards the mountain without looking back.
"Chase! Chase! "
Sun Ze got up from the ground, wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, and roared at the top of his lungs.
Only then did a few followers come to their senses and hurriedly chased after him. But after Li Hanshan broke through the fourth level of Qi Refining, the Hokage Steps became more and more mysterious. Every step he took was filled with fire, and he was able to throw them away in a blink of an eye.
"Hurry, hurry! "
Li Hanshan stared at the dense forest ahead. As long as he got into the forest, he was sure to get rid of these people.
However, at this moment, a figure fell from the sky and landed steadily ten feet in front of him, blocking his way.
The person who came was none other than Zhao Yuan.
He stood with his hands behind his back, dressed in green clothes. His spiritual power surged around his body like a mountain pressing down on top. The pressure from the foundation-building stage was unabashedly released, making Li Hanshan almost breathless.
"Run, why don't you run? "
Zhao Yuan looked at Li Hanshan condescendingly, with a hint of cat-and-mouse banter on his lips.
Li Hanshan stopped, his face ashen.
The pressure in the foundation building stage was too terrifying. After he was locked, it was difficult to even move, let alone escape.
"A broken furnace dares to ruin my good deeds? "
Zhao Yuan walked over slowly, and with every step he took, the pressure became stronger: "Do you know how rare it is to have an extremely yin body? If I get her, I can even be sure to hit the golden elixir in my lifetime! "
He stood still in front of Li Hanshan, lowered his head and looked down at the old man with gray beard and hair, his murderous intent undisguised in his eyes: "You ruined my future, I'll pay for it with your life, isn't that too much? "
Li Hanshan gritted his teeth, and the spiritual power in his body was running wildly, trying to break free from the shackles of the pressure. But the gap between Qi refining and foundation building was like a chasm, and he couldn't move at all.
He is not willing to give in!
After finally killing Hua Nongying, he encountered such a life and death crisis again!
"Don't worry, I won't let you die too happily. "
Zhao Yuan raised his hand and condensed a sharp spiritual blade on his fingertips, slowly approaching Li Hanshan's throat: "I will slowly torture you so that you can neither survive nor die."
Li Hanshan held the talisman given by Jiang Nianwei in his hand, ready to activate it at any time.
It's a pity that this is only a defensive talisman, not an attack. It must be used at the most critical time.
"Stop! "
A shout came from the sky, interrupting Zhao Yuan's words.
Immediately afterwards, a red shadow cut through the sky like a shooting star, and landed in front of Li Hanshan in an instant.
Hua Nongying was dressed in red, with flying black hair, and her alluring face was filled with coldness. She was holding a long-handled cigarette rod, with smoke curling out from the end. Her whole figure was like a rose with thorns, alluring and dangerous.
"Zhao Yuan, you are so brave! "
Hua Nongying's eyes were like daggers, staring at Zhao Yuan, and said word by word: "How dare you touch my people, just a deacon from the outer sect? "
Zhao Yuan sneered: "Hua Nongying, don't be too arrogant. You are only an inner disciple in the Qi refining stage, so what qualifications do you have to point fingers in front of me? "
"Qi refining period? "
Hua Nongying seemed to have heard some joke, her red lips slightly opened, and she sneered: "I am indeed in the Qi refining stage. But I am thirty years younger than you. I am only in my twenties. What about you? Over fifty, right? After practicing for so many years to build the foundation, you haveWhat's so proud of? "
